summary.headline: Apomasar’s Astrological Questions
summary.text: Astrological question list covering Saturn–Jupiter in Aries, the twelve places, rains, zodiacal signs versus stars, planetary significators of rulers and professions, lunar rain signs, the node, learned births, royal audiences, foreign travel, and persistent good fortune. Apomasar is repeatedly cited as an authority, with one item published in an appendix.
